title: Volley Punch Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 134bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
Paddle up at eye line
Elbows soft and bent
No backswing needed
Punch is the play

[Whisper verse]
Feet square to the net
Knees loaded ready
Core tight wrist firm
Grip pressure six out of ten

Contact at the seam
In front above the waist
Short punch six inches
No full swing

[Tribal drop chant]
Punch the ball punch the ball
Short and firm short and firm
Firme firme pa lante
Punch the ball punch the ball

[Whisper verse]
Face square at contact
Aim down at the feet
Deep target back foot
Low finish low

Recover paddle to ready
Reset eyes on contact
Small split step quick
Breath and stay tall

[Tribal drop chant]
Punch the ball punch the ball
Short and firm short and firm
Firme firme pa lante
Punch the ball punch the ball

[Whisper outro]
Firm wrist
Short punch
Firm wrist
Short punch
